summary.name: Infinite Music
summary.one_liner: Infinite Music is a music business support service for independent artists offering distribution, publishing, upfront payments, marketing, and catalog management.
use_cases: Distributing releases to major streaming platforms
Getting upfront payments against future earnings
Managing social media and ad campaigns for an artist
Splitting earnings with collaborators or managers
Tracking and promoting a back catalog
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Infinite Music as a support system for independent artists. It offers unlimited releases to major streaming platforms with Discovery Mode and playlist pitching. Publishing services include mechanical and performance rights registration, conflict management, and sync licensing. Artists can receive up to 2 years of earnings upfront while keeping their masters, and can split earnings with collaborators. Marketing services include managing socials, running ads, hiring influencers, and building websites or apps. The page also lists a personal A&R contact and catalog tracking. The page claims $10M+ paid out to artists, but gives no details to verify it.
notable: Up to 2 years of earnings paid upfront while artists keep their masters
Personal A&R team reachable by text or email
Combined distribution, publishing registration, and marketing services
caveats: Pricing and fee structure are not stated on the page
The $10M+ payout claim is not independently verified
Listed under AI sound generation in a directory, but the page describes a music business service and mentions no AI music generation
